text:
tess: Quick proposal: add a lightweight SDK header `X-RW-Routing` that carries a tiny routing tag (e.g. `tier=dedicated;bucket=canary-2`) so platform routing policies can make decisions without changing payload shapes. Goal: enable Console breakdowns + quota attribution per policy bucket.

omar: Header approach makes sense for minimal surface change. Two immediate asks: (1) how do we avoid proxies stripping it? (2) how will quota accounting treat header-driven route hints vs authoritative routing decisions?

kevin: For (1) we'll canonicalize on the edge: gateway will accept both `X-RW-Routing` and `x-rw-routing` and copy into internal metadata. We'll add a simple acceptance test to verify common proxies (nginx/istio/alb) pass it through. For (2) quotas should be charged based on resolved route after policy evaluation, but we record "route_hint" as an attribute so Console can surface discrepancies.

anya: UX note: Console needs a new per-route card showing "hinted vs resolved" distribution and a little timeline for when hints diverge from resolved routing (helps debug SDK misconfigs). Will need backend metrics: count(hints), count(resolved), count(diverged).

tess: Proposed rollout: opt-in in SDKs behind env var RD_ROUTING_HINT=enabled. Start canary (2% tenants) with SDKs emitting `X-RW-Routing: bucket=canary-2`. After 1 week, flip console feature flag to visualize, then bump to 25% and monitor quota reconciliation.

omar: SDK changes: add helper API so app code doesn't manually set raw header. Eg Python: set client.option(route_hint="canary-2") and SDK inserts header. Also add a fallback where if header cannot be delivered (e.g. network lib strips custom headers), SDK records a local metric `route_hint.failed_emit`.

kevin: Telemetry: emit a low-cardinality counter `sdk.route_hint.emitted` with tag `value:<bucket>` and `sdk.route_hint.resolved` on gateway. Sampling 0.5% for full stack traces. Also a gauge `sdk.route_hint_mismatch` per minute to track divergence. We'll wire these into existing metrics pipeline.

anya: Console backfill: for historical comparison we should allow a two-week window to start collecting hints before exposing the tile, otherwise charts will look empty. Also add a small legend that explains the semantics (hint vs route).

ci-bot: CI job queued: python-sdk-routehint-compat-check -> will run against nginx/istio local proxies.

tess: SDK compatibility: we'll add opt-in shims in TS and Go and a runtime config check that logs a warning if header emission is enabled but no hint is set. Docs PR will include examples and migration guidance.

omar: Edge-case: what if multiple SDKs in a single request chain set different hints? Gateway should keep the outermost client header only and log a trace event indicating conflicting hints. Add a trace sampling rule for that case.

kevin: Quota reconciliation: ledger should continue to bill by resolved route. Console will surface "bill attribution by hint" only as advisory. Ops needs an alert if >0.1% of tokens billed to route A had hint B more than X minutes before.

anya: UX detail: expose a toggle per-org in Console: "Show SDK routing hints" (defaults off). Also provide a CSV export of hint/resolved pairs for account teams.

ci-bot: test results: nginx pass, istio pass, aws-alb limited header support (strips some underscores). Recommendation: avoid underscores in header names.

tess: Good catch — change header to `X-RW-Routing` (no underscore). Updating SDK patch.

kevin: Security: header will be max 256 chars; strip any unexpected characters server-side to avoid injection into logs. Also mark header as non-sensitive in telemetry to avoid PII storage.

anya: Docs-bot: drafted docs stub -> /docs/routing-hint-sdk.md. Contents: intent, example snippets, console tile preview, migration checklist. I'll open a docs PR and link it here.

ci-bot: deployment note: python-sdk 1.24.0-alpha with route hint landed in canary pipeline. ts-sdk and go-sdk PRs in review.

omar: Actionable checklist: (1) SDK PRs (py/ts/go) with opt-in env + helper API, (2) gateway acceptance tests + trace for conflicts, (3) metrics emitters (counters/gauge), (4) console tile behind feature flag + CSV export, (5) ops proxy compatibility sweep, (6) docs + migration guide.

tess: I'll own coordination and open an RFC with the checklist and timeline. Thanks all. :rocket:
